title: Treasure Pairs (Two Sum)
hints: The brute force tries every pair: O(n^2). The big test will time out - you need to do better.
For each number x you need target - x. Can you remember what you have already seen?
Keep an unordered_map<int,int> from value to index. For each i, look up target - nums[i] BEFORE inserting nums[i].
